60:T1045,function solve(task, deadline) {
  const n = 320, R = 160, W = 11, T = 62;
  const hex = s => { const b = []; for (let k = 0; k < 20; k++) b.push(parseInt(s.substr(2 * k, 2), 16)); return b; };
  const H = task.h.map(hex), S = hex(task.s);

  // Row-major augmented matrix: rows j=0..159, bits 0..319 = columns, word 10 bit 0 = syndrome
  const base = new Uint32Array(R * W);
  for (let j = 0; j < R; j++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      if ((H[i][j >> 3] >> (j & 7)) & 1) base[j * W + (i >> 5)] |= (1 << (i & 31));
    }
    if ((S[j >> 3] >> (j & 7)) & 1) base[j * W + 10] |= 1;
  }

  const rows = new Uint32Array(R * W);
  const order = [...Array(n).keys()];
  const pc = x => {
    x = x - ((x >>> 1) & 0x55555555);
    x = (x & 0x33333333) + ((x >>> 2) & 0x33333333);
    return Math.imul((x + (x >>> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0F, 0x01010101) >>> 24;
  };
  const wt = a => pc(a[0]) + pc(a[1]) + pc(a[2]) + pc(a[3]) + pc(a[4]);

  while (Date.now() < deadline - 500) {
    // random column order
    for (let i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      const t = order[i]; order[i] = order[j]; order[j] = t;
    }
    // Gaussian elimination with column order -> information set
    rows.set(base);
    const piv = [];
    let rank = 0;
    for (const c of order) {
      if (rank === R) break;
      const w = c >> 5, m = 1 << (c & 31);
      let r = rank;
      while (r < R && !(rows[r * W + w] & m)) r++;
      if (r === R) continue;
      if (r !== rank) {
        for (let k = 0; k < W; k++) {
          const t = rows[r * W + k]; rows[r * W + k] = rows[rank * W + k]; rows[rank * W + k] = t;
        }
      }
      const pb = rank * W;
      for (let k = 0; k < R; k++) {
        if (k !== rank && (rows[k * W + w] & m)) {
          const kb = k * W;
          for (let q = 0; q < W; q++) rows[kb + q] ^= rows[pb + q];
        }
      }
      piv.push(c);
      rank++;
    }
    if (rank < R) continue;

    const isPiv = new Uint8Array(n);
    for (const c of piv) isPiv[c] = 1;
    const NI = [];
    for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) if (!isPiv[c]) NI.push(c);

    // transformed syndrome u and transformed non-info columns tv
    const u = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
    for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) if (rows[r * W + 10] & 1) u[r >> 5] |= 1 << (r & 31);
    const tv = NI.map(c => {
      const v = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
      const w = c >> 5, m = 1 << (c & 31);
      for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) if (rows[r * W + w] & m) v[r >> 5] |= 1 << (r & 31);
      return v;
    });

    const build = J => {
      const v = u.slice();
      for (const j of J) for (let q = 0; q < 5; q++) v[q] ^= tv[j][q];
      const pos = [];
      for (let r = 0; r < R; r++) if ((v[r >> 5] >>> (r & 31)) & 1) pos.push(piv[r]);
      for (const j of J) pos.push(NI[j]);
      pos.sort((a, b) => a - b);
      return pos;
    };

    const m = NI.length;
    if (wt(u) <= T) return build([]);

    // Lee-Brickell style: add p non-information columns, p = 1..3
    for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) {
      const a = [u[0] ^ tv[i][0], u[1] ^ tv[i][1], u[2] ^ tv[i][2], u[3] ^ tv[i][3], u[4] ^ tv[i][4]];
      if (wt(a) + 1 <= T) return build([i]);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) {
      const ti = tv[i];
      for (let j = i + 1; j < m; j++) {
        const tj = tv[j];
        const a = [u[0] ^ ti[0] ^ tj[0], u[1] ^ ti[1] ^ tj[1], u[2] ^ ti[2] ^ tj[2],
                   u[3] ^ ti[3] ^ tj[3], u[4] ^ ti[4] ^ tj[4]];
        if (wt(a) + 2 <= T) return build([i, j]);
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < m; i++) {
      const ti = tv[i];
      for (let j = i + 1; j < m; j++) {
        const tj = tv[j];
        const b = [u[0] ^ ti[0] ^ tj[0], u[1] ^ ti[1] ^ tj[1], u[2] ^ ti[2] ^ tj[2],
                   u[3] ^ ti[3] ^ tj[3], u[4] ^ ti[4] ^ tj[4]];
        for (let k = j + 1; k < m; k++) {
          const tk = tv[k];
          const s = pc(b[0] ^ tk[0]) + pc(b[1] ^ tk[1]) + pc(b[2] ^ tk[2]) +
                    pc(b[3] ^ tk[3]) + pc(b[4] ^ tk[4]);
          if (s + 3 <= T) return build([i, j, k]);
        }
        if (Date.now() > deadline - 500) break;
      }
      if (Date.now() > deadline - 500) break;
    }
  }
  return [];
}

5a:["$","details",null,{"className":"spoiler","children":[["$","summary",null,{"children":"Task text, as every rig got it"}],["$","pre",null,{"className":"term scroll","style":{"maxHeight":240},"children":"Syndrome decoding (decode), a random [320, 160] binary code.\nH is 160 by 320 over GF(2). \"h\" lists its 320 columns, each 160 bits as 20 hex bytes: bit i of the column is bit (i % 8) of byte floor(i / 8). \"s\" uses the same layout.\nFind e in GF(2)^320 with H e = s, s given in \"s\". Score: the weight of e (number of ones).\nLower is better. For scale: one Gaussian elimination gives weight about 80.\nTo close the block: score <= 62.\nAnswer: a JSON array of the positions (0-based) where the vector is 1."}]]}]
